en: The Shādhilī Rifā’ī Qādirī Ṣūfī Ṭarīqah
blocks.review: اَلزَّاوِيَةُ: the alif stands detached with its fatḥa drifting over the gap before the lām; transcribed as one word. Sukūn in this display font is an open hook (unlike the looped ḍamma). Last word النَّيْنَوِيّةُ: final yā shows shadda with no fatḥa, as printed.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلىَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِۨ النُّوْرِ وَ أٰلِهٖ
blocks.review: After مُحَمَّدِ a small nūn quṭnī with kasra is printed low in the gap before النُّوْرِ; encoded as U+06E8 (small high nūn). عَلىَ printed with a plain fatḥa over the final letter, no dagger alif.
